scenes.headline: Start with the right training
scenes.supportingText: Washington adults often lose time by guessing the first step.
scenes.captionText: Want to work in caregiving in Washington? Start with the right first step.

scenes.headline: The hard part is uncertainty
scenes.supportingText: People hesitate when they do not know the training path, format, or cost.
scenes.captionText: The biggest blocker is not motivation. It is not knowing the path.

scenes.headline: There is a practical starting path
scenes.supportingText: ExcelCNA offers DSHS-approved HCA training for adults entering caregiving.
scenes.captionText: A clear training path matters when you are starting fresh.

scenes.headline: Built for real schedules
scenes.supportingText: Mostly online training can be easier to fit around work and family.
scenes.captionText: Mostly online can make training more doable for busy adults.

scenes.headline: Check the HCA page
scenes.supportingText: Review the details and enroll when it makes sense for you.
